name: eventsli-backend
description: Eventsli API — events, seat inventory, ticketing, payments

comments.optionalDependencies: Shared rate-limit store. Without these, express-rate-limit falls back to its per-process MemoryStore — and ecosystem.config.js runs this API with instances:'max' in cluster mode, so each worker keeps its own counter and throttling becomes non-deterministic. app.js degrades gracefully with a warning when they are absent or REDIS_URL is unset.
comments.testRunner: node --test, built in. No Jest, no Mocha, no config file.
